newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African wool prices fell at latest auction.
newsitem.headline: S.African wool prices fell at latest auction.

text.p: South African wool prices were lower at the latest weekly auction, the Wool Board said.
It said 6,930 bales were offered at this week's sale, of which 96.2 percent was sold.

Price quotes for long Merino fleeces of 20 micron fell 0.3 percent, 21 micron fell 3.0 percent, 22 micron fell 2.6 percent, 23 micron fell 1.9 percent, 24 micron fell 2.5 percent and 25 micron fell 2.0 percent.
Prices for Merino bellies fell 1.0 percent, Merino lambs rose 0.1 percent and Merino locks rose 1.9 percent.
The offering included 1,820 bales of other White Wools, 1,459 bales of Ciskei/Transkei, 2,084 bales of Lesotho and 1,244 bales of coarse and coloured.

Of the 531 bales of 20 micron offered, 96.4 percent was sold. Of the 1,011 bales of 21 micron offered, 96.6 percent was sold. Of 1,044 bales of 22 micron offered, 96.7 percent was sold, Of 342 bales of 23 micron offered, 92.7 percent was sold. Of 74 bales of 24 micron offered, 94.6 percent was sold and all 32 bales of 25 micron sold hundred percent.
The next sale will take place on February 21, when 10,000 bales will be on offer.
